# The Best CortexAlternatives [...] 5.0 · 3 reviews

Learn more →

xdge AI expands the idea of enterprise search into a broader productivity layer that includes meetings and proactive insights. Compared with Cortex’s focus on durable memory and controllable retrieval for agents, xdge AI is geared toward packaged, day-to-day workflows that surface answers and recommendations quickly.

It stands out when teams want more than “find the doc,” especially with features like a smart meeting assistant and automated insights that turn conversations into usable knowledge. That makes it appealing for marketing and operations roles that need fast context, summaries, and next-step clarity across lots of moving pieces. [...] ### Standout features

 ✓Lightning-fast enterprise search
 ✓Smart meeting assistant and summaries
 ✓Automated insights and personalized recommendations
 ✓Workflow automation with safe preview mode

## Supermemory

SupermemorySupermemory

ai second brain for all your saved stuff

4.2 · 5 reviews

Learn more →

Supermemory is closer to a “second brain” than an agent infrastructure platform, which makes it a compelling Cortex alternative for people who primarily want a shared, searchable knowledge stash. Instead of leading with connectors and retrieval governance, it leads with an opinionated UX for saving, organizing, and rediscovering information.
